blogs.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Scallopini  ( Seared Chicken With Lemon Butter Pasta ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन स्कैलोपिनी (नींबू मक्खन पास्ता के साथ कटा हुआ चिकन) पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Super delicious chicken scallopini which tastes so yummy. This seared chicken tastes amazing with lemon butter spaghetti. So good.

 

Chicken Scallopini Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Italian

Serves: 1 serving

 

Ingredients

Spaghetti - 100 grams

Chicken Breast - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Oil - 2 tablespoons

Butter - 3 tablespoons

Garlic - 4 cloves chopped finely

Lemon Juice - 2 tablespoons

Chicken stock or water - ½ cup

Cream or Milk - ½ cup

Coriander leaves as needed

 

Instructions

Cook pasta as per package directions and set aside.

Mix flour with salt and pepper and mix well.

Take chicken and coat in flour. Heat oil in a pan, fry chicken on both sides till golden. Drain and set aside.

In the same pan, add butter, garlic and fry for a min.

Add in lemon juice and chicken stock and mix well.

Add in salt and mix well.

Place chicken back in and cook for 3 to 4 mins.

Now remove the chicken and turn off the heat.

Let the mix cool down.

Now add in cream and mix well.

Put it back on the heat, add in pasta and mix well.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Masala Roast ( Street Food Style ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चिकन मसाला रोस्ट (स्ट्रीट फूड स्टाइल) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Really spicy and lip-smackingly delicious street food style chicken masala roast. This taste so yummy with either roti, paratha or chapati.

This is a chicken roast or masala recipe that is so good. This recipe is spicy and kind of addictive. You will love it for sure. If you can add some lemon juice to increase the taste.

 

Street Food Style Chicken Masala Roast Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Side

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - ½ kg

Coconut Oil - 5 tablespoons

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Dry Red Chilli - 10

Garlic - 6 cloves

Onion - 2 large chopped finely

Green Chillies - 3 to 4 slit

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander leaves a handful finely chopped

 

Instructions

Soak chillies in hot water. Drain and take it in a blender. Add garlic and grind it to a smooth paste. Set aside.

Take chicken, salt and turmeric powder in a bowl and mix well. Set aside for 30 mins.

Heat oil in a pan, add onions and chillies and cook till golden.

Add in chicken and sear well. Cover and cook for 15 to 20 mins.

Add in chilli puree and mix well. Cook till it dries up.

Now add in salt, garam masala powder and pepper powder. Mix well.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Roasted Mayonnaise ( Mayo Crusted ) Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट भुना हुआ मेयोनेज़ (मेयो क्रस्टेड) चिकन पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Super delicious chicken which is baked to perfection. The chicken has a mayonnaise coating and it tastes amazing.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 15 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roasted Mayo Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Side

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken Breast - 2 slits in half

Mayonnaise - 4 tablespoons

Mustard Sauce - 2 teaspoons

Dried Oregano - 1 teaspoon

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Flakes - 2 teaspoons

Cornflour - 3 tablespoons

Lemon Juice - 2 teaspoons

Breadcrumbs

 

Instructions

Mix all the ingredients together except chicken and breadcrumbs.

Add chicken and mix well. Leave to marinate for 30 mins.

Preheat oven to 250 degrees C. Line a baking pan with foil and grease well with oil.

Place chicken on the pan and top with breadcrumbs if you like.

Pop this in the oven and cook for 10 to 12 mins until chicken is cooked.

Now place it on the top rack on the oven and turn on the grill/broil mode. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 mins till the top is golden.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Ghee Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.content:
The spicy and flavourful chicken curry which is made using some spicy toasted spice powders. The ghee adds a nice flavor to the chicken curry. So good.

 

Ghee Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Side

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Ghee - ¼ cup

Chicken - ½ kg

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Yogurt / Curd - ½ cup

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Curry leaves - 2 sprig

Tomatoes - 2 chopped finely

Tamarind pulp - 1 tablespoon

Water as needed

Salt to taste

Garam Masala Powder - 1.5 tablespoon

Coriander leaves a handful finely chopped

 

TO DRY ROAST & GRIND:

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 2 tablespoons

Coriander Powder - 2 tablespoons

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Powder - 2 teaspoons

Garlic - 6 to 8 cloves

 

Instructions

Take chicken, yogurt, salt and turmeric powder in a bowl and mix well. Set aside for 30 mins.

Take spice powders in a dry pan and toast for 2 to 3 mins. Take it in a blender and add garlic. Grind to a smooth puree.

Heat ghee in a pan, add in curry leaves.

Add onions, chilies, and salt and saute till golden.

Add in chicken and mix well. Cook for 10 mins.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Now add in the ground masala, tamarind, and water and mix well. Cook for 10 to 15 mins.

Add garam masala powder and mix well.

Cook till oil separates from the curry.

Add in coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Barbeque Pulled Chicken Sandwich Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट बार्बेक्यू चिकन सैंडविच पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
A super juicy and delicious sandwich made using leftover chicken. You can use up leftover grilled chicken or rotisserie chicken. This makes a great lunch box option as well.

Last week we had a party at home, we ordered a few grilled chicken from a nearby takeout place. I got a few leftover grilled chickens from that. I shredded the chicken the next day and made two different types of sandwiches to show you. One is this yummy barbeque chicken sliders the next one is chicken salad sandwiches.

 

Barbeque Pulled Chicken Sandwich Recipe - Leftover Chicken Recipe Ideas

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Leftover Chicken - 2 cups shredded

Oil - 1 teaspoon

Garlic - 3 cloves chopped finely

Onion - 1 sliced

Barbeque Sauce - ½ cup

Burger Buns as needed

Cheese Slice as needed

 

FOR SALAD:

Onion - ½ sliced thinly

Cabbage - 2 cups sliced thinly

Carrot - 1 sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 1 chopped finely

Coriander Leaves - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

Sugar- 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Vinegar - 1 to 2 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Mix all the ingredients for a salad and set aside.

Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and onion and saute for a min.

Add in barbeque sauce and mix well. Bring it to a boil.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Take burger bun and slit it open.

Top with the chicken filling, top with cheese slice.

Cover it up with another half.

Wrap in foil and pop it in the oven.

Bake for 5 to 8 mins.

Remove and serve it with salad.

blogs.title: Tasty Creamy Chicken Salad ( Using Leftover Chicken ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट मलाईदार चिकन सलाद (बचे हुए चिकन का उपयोग करके) पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
A delicious creamy salad which tastes so delicious. This chicken salad is easy to make and makes a great filling for sandwiches too. It tastes so yummy cold so it is perfect for summer.

If you have leftover chicken lying around then this is a delicious salad to make. It is great to put in a lunch box too. You can serve it with some bread slices or some dinner rolls and you have a yummy lunch.

 

Creamy Chicken Salad Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Salad

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Leftover Chicken - 2 cups shredded

Mayonnaise - ¼ cup or as needed

Cabbage - ¼ cup sliced thinly

Carrot - ¼ cup sliced thinly

Onion - ½ sliced thinly

Coriander Leaves - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix everything together and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken ( Using Leftover ) Salad Sandwich Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन (बचे हुए का उपयोग करके) सलाद सैंडविच पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
A delicious creamy salad which taste so delicious. This chicken salad is easy to make and makes a great filling for sandwiches too. It tastes so yummy cold so it is perfect for summer.

If you have leftover chicken lying around then this is a delicious salad to make. It is great to put in a lunch box too. You can serve it with some bread slices or some dinner rolls and you have a yummy lunch.

 

Chicken Salad Sandwich Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Ingredients

Leftover Chicken - 2 cups shredded

Mayonnaise - ¼ cup or as needed

Cabbage - ¼ cup sliced thinly

Carrot - ¼ cup sliced thinly

blogs.title: Tasty Quick Stir Fry Rice with Chicken
blogs.title_hi: चिकन के साथ स्वादिष्ट त्वरित हलचल तलना चावल
blogs.content:
Super easy and quick to make stir fry rice for kids. This recipe can be made using leftover cooked rice and chicken. A great recipe to put in kids lunch box.

This stir fry rice is super easy to make and it tastes amazing. You can add cooked veggies instead of chicken in this. You can skip the eggs in this too.

 

Stir Fry Rice for Kids

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Rice - 1 cup

Eggs - 2

Cooked Chicken - ½ cup shredded

Sweet corn - ¼ cup (frozen, thawed)

Spinach - ½ cup roughly chopped

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Butter - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Mix eggs with salt and pepper and mix well.

Heat butter in a pan.

Add in cooked rice and stir fry for 1 min.

Add in spinach, chicken and sweet corn and stir fry for 5 mins.

Now add in the egg mixture and stir fry for 6 to 8 mins till the eggs are fried well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken ( Leftover ) Wrap Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन (बचे हुए) रैप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Super easy and fast wrap recipe to use up leftover chicken. If you have some cooked chapati in the fridge then this recipe can be put together in just a few minutes.

This is a simple wrap to put together using some leftover chicken and cheese. Such an easy recipe to make and taste so delicious. Perfect to put in a kids lunch box.

 

Leftover Cheesy Chicken Wrap Recipe

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Breakfast

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 wrap

 

Ingredients

Chapati or Tortilla - 2

Tomato Ketchup or Pasta Sauce - 2 tablespoons

Cheese Slices or Grated Cheese - ¼ cup or 2 slices

Cooked Chicken Shredded - 1 cup

Onion Slices as needed (optional)

Oil - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Take chapati and spread the top with some ketchup or any sauce.

Sprinkle over cheese or cheese slice.

Top with cooked chicken and onions.

Roll it well.

Heat oil in a pan, cook till golden on both sides.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Pallipalayam Chicken Roast Recipe
blogs.content:
Such a fast and easy chicken recipe which taste so delicious. You can serve this with plain rice or rasam rice. It tastes fantastic.

Really spicy and lip-smackingly delicious chicken masala roast. This taste so yummy with either roti, paratha or chapati.

This is a chicken roast recipe that is so good. This recipe is spicy and kind of addictive. You will love it for sure. If you want to add some lemon juice to increase the taste.

 

Pallipalayam Chicken Roast Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 to 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Dry Red Chillies - 4 to 5

Curry leaves - 2 sprig

Coconut Oil - 3 tablespoons

 

FOR GRINDING:

Onion - 2 large chopped

Garlic - 12 cloves

Curry leaves a handful

Green Chillies - 3

 

Instructions

Grind the ingredients given to a coarse mixture.

Heat oil and fry curry leaves and dry red chillies.

Add in the ground masala and saute for 3 mins.

Add chicken, salt and turmeric and mix well.

Cover and cook on low heat for 25 to 30 mins keep mixing in between.

Now let the chicken roast on high heat till it well coloured.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Bread Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious and soft chicken bread which tastes so yummy and is perfect for this iftar season. Make this for your kids then will love it for sure.

This was on my bucket list for quite some time, finally, I made it a few weeks back. I had a bunch of herbs, so used those to make this dough and it was perfect. You can make this in different shapes. 

I made this herbed dough and the filling was little creamy and spicy which tasted great. I will soon share an Indian version of a filling.

 

Chicken Bread Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 20 mins

Total time: 35 mins

 

Recipe type: Brunch

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

FOR DOUGH:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 cups

Dry Yeast - 1.5 teaspoon

Sugar - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Dried Parsley - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano - 2 teaspoons

Red Chilli Flakes - 2 teaspoons

Olive Oil - 2 tablespoons

Warm Water as needed

Milk - 2 tablespoons for brushing on top

 

FOR FILLING:

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Onion - 1 large chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 chopped finely

Curry leaves a sprig

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Breast - 2 cooked and cut into small pieces

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Stock - ½ cup

 

Instructions

Take yeast, sugar in a bowl and add in warm water. Let it sit for 5 mins.

Take flour, salt, all the herbs and olive oil. Mix well.

Add yeast water and extra water and knead to a soft dough.

Add more oil on top and set aside to rise for 1 to 2 hours.

While the dough is rising. Make the filling. Heat oil in a pan,

Add in onion, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Saute for 2 mins.

Add salt and spice powders and mix well.

Add in all-purpose flour and saute for a min.

Add in Chicken stock and cooked chicken and mix well. Set aside to cool.

Once the dough has risen. Punch out the air and divide it into 2 portions.

Take a portion and roll into a large rectangle. Spoon filling inside and seal from the sides.

Now place it in a parchment-lined baking pan.

Let it rise for 30 mins to 1 hour.

In the last 10 mins of rising, preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Now brush the top with egg or milk. Bake for 20 mins.

Remove and cool a little.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken and Spinach Quesadilla Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन और पालक कुसैदिला रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Easy and healthy chicken spinach quesadillas which will be your kids favourite. This taste so good and makes a great lunch box dish.

Quesadilla is my favourite, it is nothing but any filling placed inside some tortilla along with cheese and toasted or grilled to perfection. So delicious and cheese. I have shared a few versions of quesadilla and this one is the simple one you could ever make.

 

Cheesy Chicken & Spinach Quesadillas

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 15 mins

 

Recipe type: Brunch

Cuisine: Mexican

Serves: 2 quesadillas

 

Ingredients

Leftover Chicken - 1 cups

Onion - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

Coriander Leaves - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

Chopped Spinach - 1 cup

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Cream Cheese or Cheese Spread - 2 tablespoons

Cheese Grated as needed

Chapati or Tortilla - 4

Oil - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients except grated cheese and tortilla.

Spread on one tortilla and top with cheese. Place another tortilla on top and

Pan fry in little oil till golden on both sides.

Remove and cut it into pieces

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Samosa Recipe
blogs.content:
Chicken Samosa.Super crispy and flavourful samosa recipe with a different taste filling. This taste great with a cup of coffee or tea.

Samosa is one of my all-time favourite snacks. It is recently I discovered readymade frozen samosa sheets and I am love with it. you just make filling for the samosa and stuff them in this and fry them or bake them.

 

Chicken Samosa Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 2 mins

Total time: 12 mins

 

Recipe type: Brunch

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Samosa Patti as needed

Oil for deep frying

All-Purpose flour / Maida - 2 tablespoons

Water - 2 to 3 tablespoons

 

FOR FILLING:

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Onion - 1 large chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 chopped finely

Curry leaves a sprig

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Breast - 2 cooked and cut into small pieces

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Stock - ½ cup

 

Instructions

First Make the filling. Heat oil in a pan,

Add in onion, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Saute for 2 mins.

Add salt and spice powders and mix well.

Add in all-purpose flour and saute for a min.

Add in Chicken stock and cooked chicken and mix well. Set aside to cool.

Take a samosa Patti and spoon some filling in.

Now fold like samosa and seal the edges with flour and water paste.

Deep fry till golden brown.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Kuttanadan Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious Keralan inspired chicken curry which has an addition of coconut milk in the end which makes it very creamy and delicious. This tastes great with appam, dosa, idiyappam, parota, and rice.

This spicy chicken curry has coconut milk added in this for creaminess and has a hint of black pepper in it. Will share another version that has not many tomatoes added to the curry. This one is my favourite because it has a tanginess from the tomatoes.

 

Kuttanadan Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Side

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 to 6 servings

 

Ingredients

FOR MARINATION:

Chicken - 1 kg

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder - 1 tablespoon

Garam Masala Powder - 2 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

 

FOR GRAVY:

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Mustard Seeds - 1 tsp

Curry leaves a handful

Onions - 2 large chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 to 3 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 4 large chopped finely

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 2 tablespoons

Coriander Powder - 2 tablespoons

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Black Pepper Powder - 2 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Thick coconut milk - 2 cups

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients for marination to it and mix well. Leave aside for 30 mins.

Now heat oil in a pot. Add in mustard and curry leaves.

Add in onions and cook till golden brown.

Add chillies and ginger garlic paste and mix well. Saute for 2 mins.

Now add in spice powders, salt and mix well.

Add chicken and coat well in spices.

Add in tomatoes and cook that till it is mushy.

Cover and cook the chicken for 25 to 30 mins.

Now add in coconut milk and mix well. Cover and simmer till oil floats on top.

Serve it with rice.
